vector_memory.semantic_summary: AssetService is the dedicated service layer responsible for abstracting all client-side HTTP communication related to project assets. It provides strongly-typed methods for CRUD operations, including listing, uploading, updating metadata, and streaming raw binary or text content. It consumes HttpClient and relies on models defined in omega-api.models to structure API interactions against the project asset endpoints.
